topic: Feedgas decline and the Manatee (Loran-Manatee) field as Train 1's restart prospect
wiki_text: Trinidad's upstream gas supply has declined enough that, as of late 2023, Atlantic LNG's feedstock 'has waned and can no longer keep its four liquefaction units operating' at once (SPE Journal of Petroleum Technology), which is the underlying cause of Train 1's 2020 mothballing and 2025 decommissioning decision. Shell gave financial approval in October 2023 for development of the Manatee field -- part of the cross-border Loran-Manatee reservoir shared with Venezuela (Venezuela: ~73.75%, Trinidad and Tobago: ~26.25% per a 2013 unitisation agreement) -- with a field development plan targeting peak production of 700 MMcf/d. The project was explicitly framed by the sponsor as new feedstock for Atlantic LNG. As of November 2023, Shell's final investment decision (FID) was still pending (McDermott had only 'limited notice to proceed' on engineering work at that point). GEM's own prior research (Researcher notes, Sep 2024) separately records that Shell reached FID in July 2024, with first gas targeted for 2027 -- this specific date was not independently re-verified this pass (session WebSearch budget was exhausted). No first gas has occurred as of 2026-08-11, so Train 1 correctly remains Status=mothballed; Manatee is a forward-looking restart prospect, not a current operational change.

source_urls.title: Shell Green Lights Investment in Manatee Development Off Trinidad
Manatee field one step closer to final decision

topic: Train X / Train 5 -- the fifth train that was never built
wiki_text: A fifth Atlantic LNG train ('Train X') was studied for feasibility in the mid-2000s, with a decision targeted for December 2007. Upstream Online reported in February 2007 that Trinidad had put Train X 'on the table' as a live proposal, alongside Trains 1-4's then-existing ownership consortium. The project never proceeded past feasibility/study stage and no source after 2007 documents further activity -- Atlantic LNG's current 'Our Trains' page lists only Trains 1-4. GEM's inferred ShelvedYear=2009/CancelledYear=2011 (2y/4y dormancy clock from the last known 2007 activity) are consistent with this and were not changed; only the previously-blank Status/ShelvedYear/CancelledYear/StopYear ref cells were filled this pass.

source_urls.title: Trinidad puts Train X on table
